pr_title: Fix broken "How to reproduce" lines in CSV tests
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/105017

A quick summary:
- `randomizedtesting` library doesn't handle "+" chars in test names
- We currently have the "...#[skip:..., ...]" instructions as part of the test name

As removing the instructions from the name fixes both issues (And makes launching a single test in CLI far easier), the instructions have been moved out of the test name to another parameter.

Before:
```
gradlew ':x-pack:plugin:esql:test' --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.CsvTests" -Dtests.method="test {stats.GroupByNull#[skip:-8.12.99,reason:bug fixed in 8.13+]}"
```

After:
```
gradlew ":x-pack:plugin:esql:test" --tests "org.elasticsearch.xpack.esql.CsvTests" -Dtests.method="test {stats.GroupByNull}"
```
pr_comments: I pulled this locally and intentionally broke `emptyPattern#[skip:-8.11.99]`. Then used the reproduction and it works. Yay. :+1:

issue_context.title: ESQL: broken repro lines in csv tests
issue_context.body:
CSV test cases with a [skip annotation](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/7ce8d76559f89e39b17ba1ab713b7370f37454fb/x-pack/plugin/esql/qa/testFixtures/src/main/resources/stats.csv-spec#L949) cannot be run individually, and when they fail the reproduction line does not work (`No tests found for given includes`).

To reproduce, run the csv tests but change expected result for [groupByNull](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/7ce8d76559f89e39b17ba1ab713b7370f37454fb/x-pack/plugin/esql/qa/testFixtures/src/main/resources/stats.csv-spec#L954) and attempt to use the repro line.

The issue seems to be caused by the `+` sign used in the skip reason. If we change the csv test header from
```
groupByNull#[skip:-8.12.99,reason:bug fixed in 8.13+]
```
to
```
groupByNull#[skip:-8.12.99,reason:bug fixed in 8.13]
```
the repro line works as expected.
comments: It would be nice not to see the `#[skip..` part at all in the logs and in the repro lines

I'd like to open a PR for this if the below solution is acceptable:

Instructions like `skip` beginning with `#` are no longer considered part of test names, so the `groupByNull` test may now only be matched in the repro line without its instructions: `./gradlew ... -Dtests.method="test {stats.GroupByNull}"`.

To accomplish this, test names and instructions will be factored apart when they're parsed in [SpecReader](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/main/x-pack/plugin/ql/test-fixtures/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/ql/SpecReader.java).
